description: This file contains unit tests for the api/client module, testing functions such as getApiBaseUrl, apiRequest, setAuthToken, setExtraHeaders, and getExtraHeaders. It uses Jest testing framework to mock fetch and verify API request behaviors.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for API calls, reading from environment variable and trimming trailing slash.

methods.name: apiRequest
methods.description: Sends an API request, attaches headers, and processes the response (parsing JSON or text based on response headers).

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Sets the authentication token to be used in API requests.

methods.name: setExtraHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional headers to be included in API requests.

methods.name: getExtraHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the currently set extra headers.
